Too Big for the Box

SSF-HS9-L1-10001300-HSALG1-MCF-IFN · HS Math: Algebra I
THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The Mystery Clam

As you record, the four sizes fill in. The box is Q3 minus Q1. Is the biggest clam more than 1.5 boxes above Q3?

THE SCENE

Your math class measured clams at a clam garden beach. One clam is much bigger than the rest. Is its size a mistake? You need four sizes to find out. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This mystery is about clam gardens on the Pacific coast. Long ago, Indigenous people built rock walls on beaches. The walls held the sand, and clams grew better there. Some clam gardens are more than 3,500 years old.
